test_title: SSC CHSL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2023 Shift 1).
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

An official appointed to resolve a dispute
solution: The correct answer is: **Arbitrator** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word '**arbitrator**' means a person appointed to resolve a dispute. (किसी विवाद को सुलझाने के लिए नियुक्त व्यक्ति) • It is a noun and can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. • **For example**: *The company hired an arbitrator to settle the legal dispute with their former employee.* Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • Let us look at the meaning of the other words. • **Confidante**: A person with whom one shares a secret or private matter. (वह व्यक्ति जिसके साथ कोई गुप्त या निजी मामला साझा किया जाता है) • **Soothsayer**: A person supposed to be able to foresee the future; a fortune-teller. (ऐसा माना जाता है कि एक व्यक्ति भविष्य की भविष्यवाणी करने में सक्षम है; एक भविष्यवक्ता) • **Advocate**: A person who publicly supports or recommends a particular cause or policy. (वह व्यक्ति जो सार्वजनिक रूप से किसी विशेष कारण या नीति का समर्थन या अनुशंसा करता है) f6:Tc97, The correct answer is: **Enmity**
